import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))

from do_again.browser.runtime import browser_status, browser_self_test

before = browser_status(verify_session=True)
result = browser_self_test()
after = browser_status(verify_session=True)
response = result.get("response", "")

report = {
    "passed": response.strip() == "DO_AGAIN_BROWSER_OK",
    "response": response,
    "chat_url": result.get("chat_url"),
    "mode_before": before.get("mode"),
    "mode_after": after.get("mode"),
    "pid_before": before.get("pid"),
    "pid_after": after.get("pid"),
    "authenticated_before": before.get("authenticated"),
    "authenticated_after": after.get("authenticated"),
    "session_ready_before": before.get("session_ready"),
    "session_ready_after": after.get("session_ready"),
}
print("DO_AGAIN_LIVE_ROUNDTRIP=" + json.dumps(report), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)
